stops.title: The board
stops.caption: New, following up, converted.
stops.speech: The souls pipeline is a board. Somebody moves from new, to following up, to converted, and the colour shows how overdue their contact is.

stops.title: Moving somebody along
stops.caption: Drag, or open and update.
stops.speech: Drag a card to the next lane, or open it to record what happened and set the next follow-up date.
